# Dunlinfile の設定と既定値

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-docs.mjs. -->

4種別の `dunlin init <type> <type>` が書き出した YAML を掲載しています。生成時にグローバルのモデル・OCR 設定を空にしました。グローバル設定や `init` の引数で指定したモデルと OCR は、作成時に新しいファイルへ反映されます。 [モデルの設定](mcp.md#初期化時にモデルを選ぶ)

`use` にモジュール名、`with` にその引数を書きます。ソースや辞書の相対パスは設定ファイルの場所を基準にします。モデルやパスなど、対応する項目では `${ENV_NAME}` を使えます。API キーは `api_key_env` に環境変数の名前を指定します。設定を編集したら `dunlin validate --json` で確認できます。 [モジュールと引数](modules.md)

## mcp

```yaml
init:
  version: 1
  type: mcp
# Additional parser: loader.ocr (requires dunlin add ocr).
# Scan and extract documents. Optional OCR requires a loader.ocr module.
source:
  modules:
    - use: source.filesystem
      with:
        path: ./docs
        exclude: []
    - use: loader.auto
      with:
        unsupported: error
        ocr: none
# Alternative chunking: use: chunk.structure, with: { max_chars: 1600 }.
# Normalize and split text. Additional chunking modules can replace chunk.length.
transform:
  modules:
    - use: text.normalize
      with:
        unicode: nfkc
    - use: chunk.length
      with:
        unit: characters
        size: 800
        overlap: 100
# Additional index: use: index.vector, with: { model: local-embed }.
# Build the keyword index. An optional vector index uses index.vector.
index:
  modules:
    - use: index.keyword
      with:
        tokenizer: lindera
        user_dictionary: null
# For hybrid search, add retrieval.vector and fusion.rrf before context.assemble.
# Retrieve candidates and assemble source context.
search:
  modules:
    - use: query.normalize
      with:
        unicode: nfkc
    - use: retrieval.keyword
      with:
        top_k: 10
    - use: context.assemble
      with:
        budget_chars: 4000
        retrieval: fill_budget
        max_candidates: 100
        merge_overlaps: true
        truncate_last: true
        include_headings: true
# Expose the project through its configured transport.
serve:
  transport: stdio
```

## rag

```yaml
init:
  version: 1
  type: rag
# Additional parser: loader.ocr (requires dunlin add ocr).
# Scan and extract documents. Optional OCR requires a loader.ocr module.
source:
  modules:
    - use: source.filesystem
      with:
        path: ./docs
        exclude: []
    - use: loader.auto
      with:
        unsupported: error
        ocr: none
# Alternative chunking: use: chunk.structure, with: { max_chars: 1600 }.
# Normalize and split text. Additional chunking modules can replace chunk.length.
transform:
  modules:
    - use: text.normalize
      with:
        unicode: nfkc
    - use: chunk.length
      with:
        unit: characters
        size: 800
        overlap: 100
# Additional index: use: index.vector, with: { model: local-embed }.
# Build the keyword index. An optional vector index uses index.vector.
index:
  modules:
    - use: index.keyword
      with:
        tokenizer: lindera
        user_dictionary: null
# For hybrid search, add retrieval.vector and fusion.rrf before context.assemble.
# Retrieve candidates and assemble source context.
search:
  modules:
    - use: query.normalize
      with:
        unicode: nfkc
    - use: retrieval.keyword
      with:
        top_k: 10
    - use: context.assemble
      with:
        budget_chars: 4000
        retrieval: fill_budget
        max_candidates: 100
        merge_overlaps: true
        truncate_last: true
        include_headings: true
# Generate a sourced answer from the search context.
ask:
  modules:
    - use: answer.generate
      with:
        model: answerer
        cite: true
        on_no_evidence: decline
models:
  answerer:
    provider: ollama
    kind: chat
    base_url: http://localhost:11434
    model: null
# Expose the project through its configured transport.
serve:
  transport: http
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 4318
  endpoints:
    - responses
    - search
    - mcp
  access:
    allowed_hosts:
      - localhost
      - 127.0.0.1
    allowed_origins: []
    auth:
      type: none
      token_env: null
  limits:
    max_request_bytes: 1048576
    request_timeout_seconds: 120
    max_concurrent: 8
```

## wiki

```yaml
init:
  version: 1
  type: wiki
about:
  title: wiki
  purpose: ""
  out_of_scope: ""
models:
  writer:
    provider: ollama
    kind: chat
    base_url: http://localhost:11434
    model: null
ingress:
  modules:
    - use: loader.auto
      with:
        unsupported: error
        ocr: none
    - use: index.keyword
      with:
        tokenizer: trigram
        short_query: bigram
    - use: wiki.write
      with:
        model: writer
        rules: ./rules.md
        max_pages_per_job: 20
    - use: citation.verify
      with:
        on_failure: reject
query:
  modules:
    - use: wiki.search
      with:
        include_archived: false
    - use: wiki.answer
      with:
        model: writer
verify:
  modules:
    - use: check.citations
      with: {}
    - use: check.stale_versions
      with: {}
    - use: check.links
      with: {}
    - use: check.orphans
      with: {}
  content:
    - use: check.contradictions
      with:
        model: writer
        scope: changed_and_related
archive:
  modules:
    - use: wiki.archive
      with:
        keep_links: true
# Expose the project through its configured transport.
serve:
  transport: http
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 4319
  endpoints:
    - web
  access:
    allowed_hosts:
      - localhost
      - 127.0.0.1
    allowed_origins: []
    auth:
      type: none
      token_env: null
  limits:
    max_request_bytes: 1048576
    request_timeout_seconds: 120
    max_concurrent: 8
  pages: ./site
```
